name: Software end-of-support dates
description: Release, end-of-active-support, end-of-life (EOL) and end-of-security-support dates per major version of widely used software. Covers LTS release schedules for Node.js, Python, Ubuntu, PostgreSQL, PHP and more. Answers 'when does Node.js 18 reach end of life', 'is Python 3.9 still supported' and 'which iOS SDK version does Xcode require' — the questions assistants get wrong because support dates change every release cycle.
